title: Cheapest Gyms Christchurch
meta_desc: Discover the most affordable gyms in Christchurch with no contract options, prices, and compare deals with Exercise NZ subsidy for up to 70% off
intro: Christchurch offers a range of affordable gym options with competitive pricing. City Fitness stands out as the cheapest option, while Anytime Fitness provides a no-contract alternative. The Exercise NZ subsidy programme offers the biggest discount available for eligible members.

sections.heading: Most Affordable Options
sections.body: City Fitness is the most affordable gym in Christchurch, with a price of $18.99 per week on a month-to-month basis. This deal provides full-service access to their facilities without a long-term contract. Anytime Fitness offers a no-contract option with 24/7 access to over 5,000 clubs worldwide.
list: Anytime Fitness: no-contract option with 24/7 access

sections.heading: No-Contract Alternatives
sections.body: For those who prefer flexibility, several gyms in Christchurch offer no-contract options. Anytime Fitness provides 24/7 access to their facilities, while Les Mills has introduced a Flexi Membership with no lock-in contract. Additionally, the Exercise NZ subsidy programme can be used with various gyms, including City Fitness, to receive a discounted membership.
list: Les Mills: Flexi Membership, no lock-in contract

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy Programme
sections.body: The Exercise NZ subsidy programme offers the biggest discount available for eligible members, with up to 70% off gym memberships. This programme is available for new members or those who have been inactive for 12 months or more. By combining the subsidy with an affordable gym option, Christchurch residents can significantly reduce their gym membership costs.
list: Available for new members or those inactive for 12+ months
